name: Teens Teach Tech (Santa Barbara Public Library)
what_you_do: You learn robotics and coding. Then you work in pairs. You plan and lead one robotics program for children. You plan and lead one for teens at the library. There are six programs in all.
who_can_apply: Teens ages 14 to 17 with strong communication skills, an interest in coding or robotics, and the ability to work well with teens and children. No experience needed. Limited spots for highly motivated teens.
pay_detail: Unpaid. About 52 community service hours in total.
duration: November 2026 to June 2027, about 2 hours a week (schedule to be set)
how_to_apply: Online application form (linked from the library news post).
notes: Meets at Central Library, 40 E. Anapamu St. Posted October 4, 2026, so the deadline is close. Supported by a federal library grant.
